title: Playing advertising wagons and trucks
summary: He describes playing on furniture wagons and then trucks to advertise dances, and how the trucks replaced wagons.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Well, this covers your life I think pretty well. There's another minute or so on there if there's anything else that you can think of about your life. I was going to ask one thing. Did you ever play on any wagons advertising? I saw you on one truck later, you know, in 1943.
But when you were younger, when you started in 1925, did they have wagons advertising?

They had wagons then. So they had trucks and they had, some people had their furniture wagons. And they put the furniture, I played in the furniture wagons, you know, with our appetite. But it didn't last long after I started out. Probably about to want the truck cause he could get around faster than the truck. And that's why they come in to cutting the wagons out. Cause this old bass player, he hauled us around in this wagon. I can't call his name. He's dead now. He's an old fella. He used to play bass with us. He died. Well, he had a waggon and horse. Well, the musician to try to get him the job, to haul him around so he could make the money. Well, I played in his wagon once. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. I didn't stay in the wagon long. They started getting trucks. After people was able to get trucks, they'd get the trucks. Cause they said they could get around appetite more further and quicker.
Yeah. They were more solid too. Yeah.
Cause see the wagon, you couldn't get around like you want. It was too slow.
But it was alright, appetite in them wagons. But the wagon was good as a truck. Cause some of them wagons was too narrow, you see.
Uh-huh. So they started getting trucks after that. It was a pleasure getting a truck.

The best truck to ride in though, the appetite is a truck with the top on. Oh, yeah. See them wagons and them trucking down on top on. The music sounded good to the people, but it was hard to us. Yeah, it was really hard.
